expectations.text: report.pdf exists in outputs and has exactly 1 page

expectations.text: The new ranking explicitly gives growth more weight than audience size, and the response says so
expectations.evidence: 'нові ваги: зростання=2.0, розмір=0.5' and says growth matters more

expectations.text: Growth figures for the new languages carry an uncertainty measure (interval or confidence level)

expectations.evidence: Describes the 'first analysis' as VI #1 / TR #2, which were not its own earlier results (its own ranking was PL, VI, TR)
